newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening mixed to lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening mixed to lower.

text.p: With bonds and futures lower, Wall Street stocks were expected to follow through on Monday's uneven performance to open mixed to weaker.

Analysts said they did not expect a strong reaction from shares of WMX Technologies Inc after its board said today it had approved a two-year program to buy back 50 million shares and that it would accelerate the move with a Dutch auction of about $1 billion.
"(The shares) have had too much of a run already in anticipation of the news," one analyst said.
